ai.title: Claude Search/Replace File Editing Pipeline
ai.summary: Added `generate-patch-search-replace.ts` to handle file edits using Claude's search/replace blocks instead of full file rewrites. Updated `generate-diffs-prompt.ts` and `system-prompt.ts` to support `EXISTING_CODE_MARKER` and `<search>`/`<replace>` directives for precise line-by-line modifications. Refactored `env.mjs` to use `path.join` for robust environment file resolution.

eli5.text: When the assistant rewrites a file you're working on, it used to regenerate the entire file from scratch, which meant it had to reproduce every line correctly. Now, it can make targeted edits by finding a specific block of text and replacing just that part with a new version, leaving the surrounding code intact. The assistant also got more reliable at locating your project's configuration files on different computers, so it stops misreading settings in some setups. These improvements apply to all conversations today.

ai.title: Fix message saving for tool calls and warmup calls
ai.summary: Claude stream handler now detects end of turn via 'usage' presence in message_delta instead of checking stop_reason === 'end_turn'. This fixes bug where messages were not saved during tool calls and warmup calls. Backend files claude.ts, main-prompt.ts, request-files-prompt.ts updated. Removed debug console.log in main-prompt.ts onTagEnd handler and made userId parameter explicitly nullable in warmCacheForRequestRelevantFiles.

eli5.text: When you have Claude use tools or go through a warmup step, your messages were sometimes not being saved. Now the system correctly detects the end of Claude's turn during these specific interactions, so your messages will be saved as expected. You might notice that conversations that previously disappeared during tool use or initial warming now persist properly.
